# About this thesis

This is the landing page for Joshua Wilson, Ph.D.'s dissertation, "From AI Feedback to Independent Writing: Evaluating a Revision and Goal-Setting Routine in Middle School",
at University of Delaware (Ph.D. in Educational Psychology (already earned; this project is a research study and journal manuscript)).

The thesis is rendered via Quarto + XeLaTeX to a PDF whenever you push changes
to `ui/www/` or `R/`; a stable copy is committed to `docs/thesis.pdf` by the
`build-thesis.yml` workflow.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
**Read it:** [the thesis PDF](thesis.pdf) (latest CI build) · [the R package
reference](r-package.qmd) (functions, rendered from the roxygen docs).
:::
